summary: Hamilton claims his first Ferrari pole at Mexico City after a three-year drought, setting up a potential statement victory for the Scuderia's championship charge. Verstappen carries grid penalties into Sunday's race following his Friday collision with Lawson, handing rivals a rare opening to capitalize on Red Bull vulnerability at a high-altitude circuit that punishes engine performance. A win here could reshape the title fight's momentum, with Ferrari hungry to close the gap and Verstappen fighting to contain damage from an uncharacteristic mistake.
